items.headline: US Envoys Hold Peace Talks in Kyiv Following Moscow Summit
items.summary: U.S. envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv to discuss potential peace frameworks after holding talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. The high-stakes diplomatic effort marks a critical moment in negotiations to end the war, with discussions expected to expand to include European allies.

items.headline: German Startup Isar Aerospace Achieves First Private Rocket Launch to Orbit from Continental Europe
items.summary: German space startup Isar Aerospace successfully launched its Spectrum rocket into orbit from the Andøya Spaceport in Arctic Norway on September 5, 2026. The uncrewed mission safely deployed five small satellites, marking the first time a privately funded launch vehicle has achieved orbit from continental Europe.

items.headline: Alcaraz and Sabalenka Advance to US Open Quarterfinals
items.summary: Defending champions Carlos Alcaraz and Aryna Sabalenka both earned straight-set victories on Sunday to advance to the quarterfinals of the US Open. Alcaraz defeated American Tommy Paul, while Sabalenka overcame Taylor Townsend to keep her title defense and top world ranking on track.

items.headline: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" Tops Box Office for Sixth Consecutive Week as Summer Revenue Nears Record
items.summary: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" remained the top film at the domestic box office for a sixth consecutive weekend, earning an estimated $18 million over the three-day frame. The achievement comes as total North American summer theater revenues closed in on a near-record $4.75 billion over the holiday weekend.
